notes.title: Update 1.0.5 - Release notes
notes.notes:
Finally found the time to push the new update! 

This is mostly a maintenance and stability update, with a lot of performance improvements, UI polish, added control features, and Steam cloud saves!

Here's the full list:

- Input improvements and more controllers supported

- Improved Controller mapper screen

- Performance and compatibility improvements

- Screen refresh rate options added

- Retina screen Mac improvements

- Steam Cloud saves

- Graphics and UI improvements

Please get in touch if you have feedback or any issue with the new version, and thanks again for playing Oath!
